Pakistan reports counter-terrorism operations in Balochistan

Pakistan's government has stated that security forces killed 88 individuals designated as terrorists in Balochistan between July 5 and the present. This operation follows a significant attack by the Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA). The government claims these actions are part of a broader counter-terrorism effort.
